say:2:1460134001:1.text: Truly a battle unlike any other. My eyes have been opened.
say:2:1460134001:1.source_cn: 真是一场别开生面的战斗，让我大开眼界。

say:3:1460134002:1.text: I believed all from Eironn's homeland would wield the sword as he does. Yet Bryon fights with a style as different as fire is from frost.
say:3:1460134002:1.source_cn: 我原以为在埃隆的故乡，应当大家都是像他一样的剑术高手，...

say:4:1460134003:1.text: A perfect combination between him and Elona. One waits in the air, silent before the dive. The other calls leaves to dance, forming a shield below. Together, they trap all enemies between them.
say:4:1460134003:1.source_cn: 与艾洛娜之间的组合，一者在空中伺机待发，一者则召唤叶刃...

say:5:1460134004:1.text: Even when caught off guard, you shift between attack and defense with ease. The battle becomes a dance of wit and movement.
say:5:1460134004:1.source_cn: 即使被突袭，也能巧妙地攻守变换，让战斗更加灵活巧妙。

say:6:1460134005:1.text: Well, yes. Our daily patrols need Elona to serve as an agent of reconnaissance. She is used to battle.
say:6:1460134005:1.source_cn: 是的，因为日常需要巡逻，艾洛娜更多的时候会做为负责侦查...

say:7:1460134006:0.text: If someone attacks her, I'll counterattack right away. Similarly, if someone attacks me, Elona will swoop down from the sky and launch a surprise strike.
say:7:1460134006:0.source_cn: 如果有人针对她攻击，我就会作为主攻方，同样，如果有人直...

say:8:1460134007:1.text: You read each other like the wind reads the trees. That bond turns your unity into strength.
say:8:1460134007:1.source_cn: 你们彼此敏锐的感知更是为这良好的组合锦上添花。

say:9:1460134008:1.text: At that moment, a familiar voice rings out, clear and unmistakable...
say:9:1460134008:1.source_cn: 正当此时，旁边传来了熟悉的声音……

say:13:1460134009:1.text: Truly excellent. Both the battle and commentary were fantastic.
say:13:1460134009:1.source_cn: 真是太出色了，无论是刚刚二位的战斗，还是这位的点评。

say:14:1460134010:1.text: Oh, Bryon, you should've told us we had guests, and that one of them was <style="stress"><player_name></style>! We haven't seen him in forever!
say:14:1460134010:1.source_cn: 布莱恩，你也太小气了，来了新客人不告诉我们，<styl...
say:14:1460134010:1.male: Oh, Bryon, you should've told us we had guests, and that one of them was <style="stress"><player_name></style>! We haven't seen him in forever!
say:14:1460134010:1.female: Oh, Bryon, you should've told us we had guests, and that one of them was <style="stress"><player_name></style>! We haven't seen her in forever!

say:15:1460134011:1.text: If we hadn't been walking nearby, we wouldn't have been able to witness the legendary Bryon in action.
say:15:1460134011:1.source_cn: 要不是我们正好在附近商量事情，还看不到我们的布莱恩大人...

say:16:1460134012:1.text: Master Pang said he wanted to visit his friend and didn't want to disturb too many people.
say:16:1460134012:1.source_cn: 因为潘表示只是前来访友，不想惊动太多人。

say:17:1460134013:1.text: It's because of Eironn and <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s reputation for helping people that we are standing here right now.
say:17:1460134013:1.source_cn: 同样，由于埃隆的高评价与<style=stress><...
say:17:1460134013:1.male: It's because of Eironn and <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s reputation for helping people that we are standing here right now.
say:17:1460134013:1.female: It's because of Eironn and <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s reputation for helping people that we are standing here right now.

say:20:1460134015:1.text: ... Well, <style="stress"><player_name></style> is helpful most of the time, but sometimes, he can be a little mean.
say:20:1460134015:1.male: ... Well, <style="stress"><player_name></style> is helpful most of the time, but sometimes, he can be a little mean.
say:20:1460134015:1.female: ... Well, <style="stress"><player_name></style> is helpful most of the time, but sometimes, she can be a little mean.

say:23:1460134017:1.text: It's an honor to meet you both. I'm Pang.
say:23:1460134017:1.source_cn: 很荣幸见到二位，我是潘。

say:24:1460134018:1.text: After the introductions and a few friendly words, Master Pang shares why he has come...
say:24:1460134018:1.source_cn: 彼此互通姓名，寒暄一番后，潘告知了自身的来意……

say:25:1460134019:1.text: So, you want to observe different fighting techniques... What a coincidence?!
say:25:1460134019:1.source_cn: 想要观摩不同的战斗技艺啊……这不是巧了吗！

say:26:1460134020:1.text: Yeah, just now, Lyca and I were discussing how to improve the combat skills of the Dusk Patrollers and Thorned Guards.
say:26:1460134020:1.source_cn: 刚刚我和莱卡在商量的就是如何磨练薄暮巡游者和荆棘卫队战...

say:27:1460134021:0.text: Things have been too peaceful lately. Even the Dusk Patrollers are getting bored with their rounds, and the Thorned Guards are starting to forget what action looks like.
say:27:1460134021:0.source_cn: 最近有些太过和平了，薄暮巡游者几乎快成了纯粹的巡逻队员...

say:28:1460134022:1.text: That's the reason I came to see Parisa. We planned to discuss this issue over tea.
say:28:1460134022:1.source_cn: 所以我来找帕瑞莎，打算喝着花茶讨论下方案。

say:29:1460134023:0.text: Two sips in, and then I heard the sounds of battle. Oh, I have a great idea!
say:29:1460134023:0.source_cn: 结果刚喝两口，就听见你们的战斗声——而现在，我有了个更...

say:30:1460134024:1.text: We can have our friendly neighbor mage spar with us, and have our new guest here critique our fighting style.
say:30:1460134024:1.source_cn: 当然是——让我们出色的魔法师大人与我们演习一场，再请这...
say:30:1460134024:1.male: We can have our friendly neighbor mage spar with us, and have our new guest here critique our fighting style.
say:30:1460134024:1.female: We can have our friendly neighbor mage spar with us, and have our new guest here critique our fighting style.

say:31:1460134025:1.text: Parisa and I haven't let loose in a while. What do you two think? Would you lend us a hand?
say:31:1460134025:1.source_cn: 我和帕瑞莎也很久没活动过筋骨了，就给我们这个机会吧？

choice_prompt:32:1460134025.text: Parisa and I haven't let loose in a while. What do you two think? Would you lend us a hand?
choice_prompt:32:1460134025.source_cn: 我和帕瑞莎也很久没活动过筋骨了，就给我们这个机会吧？

say:33:1460134026:1.text: To witness your martial arts practice with my own eyes, it would be an honor.
say:33:1460134026:1.source_cn: 当然，能亲眼观看贵方的武学演习，是我的荣幸才是。

say:34:1460134027:1.text: Then, I'll gather some people, and we can get started.
say:34:1460134027:1.source_cn: 事不宜迟，我来召集队员，准备开始吧！

choice:32:0:1.text: I'm fine. What about you, Pang?
choice:32:0:1.male: I'm fine. What about you, Pang?
choice:32:0:1.female: I'm fine. What about you, Pang?

say:36:1460134016:1.text: Yes, the Dark Forest never refuses a guest's request, let alone someone who is Eironn's friend.
say:36:1460134016:1.source_cn: 薄暮丛林不会拒绝友善客人的请求，更何况还是埃隆的朋友。
